director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter yani boundary naapenge—cricket ground ke chaaron taraf ki line jaisa. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Cricket pitch ke chaaron taraf rope lagani ho, toh tum boundary ki poori length naapogi—isi ko perimeter kehte hain. Tum kaise naapogi?
Koi baat nahi, Riya. Polygon ka perimeter nikalne ke liye uski sabhi sides ki lengths add karte hain. Rectangle ki sides kaise jodogi?
Riya, 4 nahi—rectangle mein opposite sides equal hoti hain. Ek round ka perimeter 2 times 50 plus 30, yani 160 m hota hai. 3 rounds ke liye kya karogi?
Riya, ek round rectangle ki chaar sides hoti hain: 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, total 160 m. Ab 3 rounds mein 160 ko 3 se multiply karna hai. Tum likho.
Theek hai, Riya. Ab perimeter ka rule use karke ek chhota triangle wala question try karte hain. Ek triangle ki sides 5 cm, 6 cm aur 9 cm hain. Iska perimeter kya hai?
